messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: `metrics.scrape_failure_count > 0` for `job=metrics-collector` across eu-west-1 and us-east-1, severity=high
Alice M: got the page — I'm oncall. any customer-facing impact?
Bob L: acked on PD, standing by. seeing scrape error spikes for 3 collector pods in eu-west-1.
Carla S: looks like exporter 10.0.12.3 is returning 500 on /metrics, others showing high scrape latency.
Dan R: rolling restart of metrics-collector-deployment? replicas=6, currently 3 failing.
Alice M: hold on, checking logs and kafka lag. runbook step 1: confirm missing metrics and estimate impact.
Bob L: Prometheus query that shows gap: `absent_over_time(up{job="metrics-collector"}[5m])` returning matches for exporter.
Carla S: log snippet from exporter:
```
ERROR metric_handler: failed to collect metrics: http timeout to downstream service
stack: timeout after 10s
```
Dan R: adding temporary scrape timeout bump to 15s for job to avoid thundering retries — applying change to prom-scrape-config via k8s configmap now.
Alice M: doing it. patch applied to configmap prom-scrape-config -> kubectl rollout restart prometheus-server
Bob L: also scaling metrics-collector replica set to 9 to spread load while we investigate. `kubectl scale deploy metrics-collector --replicas=9 -n infra`
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation will trigger in 8m if unresolved.
Carla S: I see high downstream latency to storage backend (s3 proxy) causing exporter timeouts. Eng-infra incident from earlier might be related.
Alice M: note for customer impact — ingestion windows delayed, dashboards show incomplete metrics for customers using agent-based scraping. likely partial data loss for last ~4m.
Support Lead: heads up to customer ops — preparing a brief to send to affected accounts. any ETA?
Dan R: after scale and restart, exporters recover 1 by 1. currently 4/6 healthy in eu-west-1, us-east-1 unaffected.
Bob L: continuing to monitor. setting short eval queries: `rate(scrape_errors_total{job="metrics-collector"}[1m])`
Alice M: mitigation succeeded for most pods, but one exporter keeps flapping — open ticket to dev owning exporter for follow-up. creating internal issue: INC-4589.
Carla S: recommend keeping scrape timeout=15s for 30m then revert. also enabling a temporary prom relabel to exclude the misbehaving target if it keeps raising false positives.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: manual reassign suggested — primary oncall Bob L transferring to Alice M for next 30m due to infra context.
Alice M: taking handoff. Bob, can you add anything to the PD note before you go?
Bob L: added notes: scale, timeout bump, rollout restart, follow-up INC-4589, no active customer outages beyond delayed metrics. tl;dr low customer impact but visible gaps on dashboards for ~5-10m.
Support Lead: I'll hold on outbound comms until we confirm final recovery. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Dan R: will follow up with a postmortem section on exporter reliability and recommend circuit-breaker or retry strat improvements.
Alice M: closing PD alarm once we see sustained 10m of no scrape_errors. monitoring window started. last checks look green.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert resolved (auto) — marked as closed after no further fires.
Alice M: reassigning to oncall-who-is-next for longer-term follow-up. thread done, will capture timeline in INC-4589.
